title: Job queue shared by every instance
prompt: The app will run on several servers, so background jobs must be kept in the Postgres database and shared by every instance whenever DATABASE_URL is set (without DATABASE_URL, keep the default in-memory queue). Also create src/jobs.ts with a job named "count-notes" whose input is an empty object and that logs how many notes exist with console.log, and register the jobs module in src/app.ts.
